versions.changelog:
Initial release of CA File Processor.

- Supports automated processing of PDF, Excel (.xlsx/.xls), CSV, JPG, and PNG files commonly used by Indian CA firms.
- Extracts key fields (GSTIN, invoice number, totals, dates, etc.) and tables from documents.
- Auto-detects file type and routes to the correct extraction script.
- Includes OCR support for scanned PDFs and images (English + Hindi).
- Outputs structured JSON for easy analysis, summarisation, and answering user queries.
- All processing is done locally for privacy; no data is sent externally.
